taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: Each supported launchpad/DEX route defines a versioned finite state machine from creation through bonding, migration, stabilization, expansion, distribution, or failure.
State transitions use deterministic provider/chain evidence, tolerate delayed aggregate providers, and preserve ambiguity when migration or pool identity is unresolved.
Feature thresholds, cohorts, monitoring cadence, and execution assumptions are state-specific; one global new-token threshold set is prohibited.
Post-migration quality distinguishes bot/route burst from retained buyer breadth, liquidity survival, repeat buyers, and secondary expansion.
Unsupported launchpads remain capability-unavailable and cannot be inferred from token names or social claims.
